structuralFindings: CURRENCY SURPRISE: only KES (Kenyan Shillings) rates are provided — no USD file exists in this property's folder at all, unlike every other property in this batch which had a USD Non-Resident option. If a USD quote is needed for this property, it does not exist in the source and would need to be requested or converted (flag conversion as an estimate, not a source figure).

Rates are NOT purely per-person or purely per-unit — each apartment category has separate line items for 'Single occupancy', 'Double occupancy', 'Each additional person', and 'Children' rates, i.e. a hybrid per-unit-with-occupancy-add-ons structure, closer to Leopard Beach's Residence model than a flat per-person or per-unit rate.
Base meal plan is Bed & Breakfast for the 1BR/2BR/2BR-Deluxe categories; the 4-Bedroom Villa is ROOM ONLY at every duration shown (no B&B base rate given for the villa).

Rates are given at FIVE different durations per category: per night, per week, per 2 weeks, per 3 weeks, and per month (month is Room Only even for categories whose shorter durations are B&B) — a much more granular duration ladder than any other property in this batch.

Several duration/season cells are simply BLANK in the source table (e.g. 2BR Apartment's 2-week and 3-week rates have no figure in the 23-Dec-25/6-Jan-26 peak column; 2BR Deluxe's 3-week and monthly rates likewise blank for peak; 4BR Villa's monthly rate blank for peak). These are recorded as null below — treat as 'not offered at that duration during Peak', not as zero or an extraction failure.

Children age bracket is inconsistent WITHIN this single document: '1 Bedroom Apartment' table says 'Children 4-11 Years' (per-night/week) but its own 'Rate per month' row says 'Children 4-12 Years'; the 2BR and 2BR Deluxe tables say 'Children 4-11 Years' for per-night, then '5-11 Years' at longer durations. This inconsistency is in the source itself, not an extraction error — flagged rather than silently normalized.
Separate 'Children's policy' footer states Under 4 years free of charge when sharing with adults — consistent with the per-category child rates being for ages 4+.
Monthly/weekly (long-stay) rates explicitly EXCLUDE power/water, charged separately — a distinct exclusion not seen at other properties.

Restaurant meal supplements (Breakfast/Half Board/Full Board) are priced separately per person per day and clearly marked 'on top of Bed & Breakfast' for HB/FB — meaning the base B&B rate is retained and these are true add-ons, not full meal-plan replacements.
Document says 'Valid from 1st June 2025! All previous prices become invalid' and 'Prices are subject to change without notice' — a live/informal rate sheet rather than a signed contract document.
